Response: I've been working with IntelliArts since 2018. It has been a pleasure working with you guys. I appreciate our partnership very much.
Opportunities for Team to Assume Additio: It is hard to provide an answer for the entire IntelliArts team, as we have multiple teams and the level of my involvement and attention required varies between teams. Some (most) teams are highly independent and I can trust them to always be on top of things, other teams are less so. It also depends on the Product Manager and how well the collaboration between the PM and the TL is working. Generally speaking, what I'd expect each team (and not just the TL) to do/improve to free my time includes: seek to have full clarity on team's priorities and context around them (why it is important, how it aligns with company goals, what value we are adding to the customer), contribute to the Roadmap with own ideas (vs. just relying on the PM to supply them), follow up on any open questions, proactively work through ambiguity, collaborate with other teams across the org as needed, be responsive to inquiries/requests from other teams, strive to complete projects as quickly as possible without sacrificing quality and reliability of the product.
Gaps in Team Collaboration: Overall, I am happy with the skills and attitude of the team. There are a few HubSpot practices though that are not yet widely employed by the team. I have discussed it with the team and everyone agreed to strive to do better. That includes: Continuous Deployment (auto-deploy) of services owned by the team, more frequent PRs, and reduced PR cycle (time between PR is opened and merged).
Service Improvement Suggestions and Addi: My only wish is that TLs/ELs/IA management would have a tighter control over the performance of individual contributors on the team. HubSpot expectations are very clear (and very high). Since the team is pretty big, I'd like it to not be my responsibility to watch over everyone's performance. Any concerns with an individual's performance should be brought up to me as soon as possible.
